mapper.select: /** selectPrivateEntryFolderByUserId */ SELECT folder_id, folder_name, create_user_id, create_time, folder_type, resource_scope_user_id, resource_owner_id, access_policy, parent_folder_id, uuid FROM folder_tb WHERE folder_type = 1 AND resource_scope_user_id = #{userId} AND parent_folder_id is null AND status = 1

/** selectTeamEntryFolderByTeamId */ SELECT folder_id, folder_name, create_user_id, create_time, folder_type, resource_scope_user_id, resource_owner_id, access_policy, parent_folder_id, uuid FROM folder_tb WHERE folder_type = 2 AND resource_scope_team_id = #{teamId} AND parent_folder_id is null AND status = 1

/** selectTeamEntryFolderByTeamId */ SELECT f.folder_id, f.folder_name, f.uuid, f.parent_folder_id FROM folder_tb f JOIN team_tb t ON t.team_id = f.resource_scope_team_id WHERE t.uuid = #{teamUuid} AND folder_type = 2 AND f.status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rel_user_team_tb rut WHERE rut.user_id = #{userId} AND rut.team_id = t.team_id )

/** selectPrivateFolderContentsTotalCount */ SELECT COUNT(folder_contents.*) FROM (SELECT uuid as folder_content_uuid, 1 as folder_content_type FROM folder_tb WHERE parent_folder_id = #{parentFolderId} AND resource_scope_user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT file.uuid as folder_content_uuid, 2 as folder_content_type FROM file_tb file JOIN folder_tb folder ON folder.folder_id = file.folder_id WHERE file.folder_id = #{parentFolderId} AND folder.resource_scope_user_id = #{userId}
) folder_contents

/** selectPrivateFolderContentsList */ SELECT uuid, parent_folder_uuid, entry_name, folder_content_type, create_time FROM (SELECT uuid as uuid, (SELECT uuid FROM folder_tb parent WHERE parent.folder_id = folder.parent_folder_id) as parent_folder_uuid, folder_name as entry_name, 1 as folder_content_type, create_time FROM folder_tb folder WHERE parent_folder_id = #{parentFolderId} AND resource_scope_user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT file.uuid as uuid, (SELECT uuid FROM folder_tb where folder_id = file.folder_id)as parent_folder_uuid, file_name as entry_name, 2 as folder_content_type, file.create_time FROM file_tb file JOIN folder_tb folder ON folder.folder_id = file.folder_id WHERE file.folder_id = #{parentFolderId} AND folder.resource_scope_user_id = #{userId} ) folder_contents ORDER BY folder_content_type ASC, entry_name ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(folder_contents.*) FROM (SELECT uuid as folder_content_uuid, 1 as folder_content_type FROM folder_tb WHERE parent_folder_id = #{parentFolderId} AND resource_scope_team_id = (SELECT team_id from team_tb where uuid = #{teamUuid}) UNION ALL SELECT file.uuid as folder_content_uuid, 2 as folder_content_type FROM file_tb file JOIN folder_tb folder ON folder.folder_id = file.folder_id WHERE file.folder_id = #{parentFolderId} AND folder.resource_scope_team_id = (SELECT team_id from team_tb where uuid = #{teamUuid})
) folder_contents
